summary: The review capability-class binding gains external_effect so review evidence can be bound at the steps that hold produced work; CD-0138's mandatory refine step is external_effect, so without this binding no contract can ever bind review evidence. Amends CD-0117 D1 for review only; the research binding, checkpoint and terminal exclusions, and worker fences are unchanged.
title: The review lane dispatches at the steps that hold produced work
